title: Creative catalogue: twenty editorial formats
status_note: The following banks were materialized from the 10 October 2026 catalogue and are preserved here as usable text. They remain proposals. The catalogue's earlier statement that a second film was in progress and that zero twelve-style slots were qualified is a historical assembly snapshot; it is not today's completed-film ledger. This guide does not retroactively mark individual catalogue recipes rendered because a similarly named film exists.

records.structure: A question, visible cause, resulting change, bounded takeaway.
records.gate: Show a single causal chain and state model limits.

records.structure: Setup, fair question, quiet thinking beat, result, explanation.
records.gate: Do not use guessing to teach emergency response.

records.structure: A concrete starting state, two or three decisions, checked outcome.
records.gate: Verify every instructional step against the chosen source.

records.structure: Matched conditions, one stated difference, observed consequence.
records.gate: Counterfactual outcomes remain hypotheses until validated.

records.structure: Show an outcome, inspect clues backward, replay the verified chain.
records.gate: Sequence must support causality rather than merely correlation.

records.structure: A want, obstacle, choice, consequence and closing image.
records.gate: A lesson is a theme, not evidence for a general factual claim.

records.structure: The protagonist faces two costs and commits to one path.
records.gate: Both branches must be plausible within the established world.

records.structure: The viewer sees a clue the character misses until the payoff.
records.gate: Stage clues fairly and avoid a hidden last-second solution.

records.structure: A simple task escalates through linked attempts and resolves.
records.gate: Every gag should follow from the previous action.

records.structure: Retell a causal scene from a prop or helper's perspective.
records.gate: Change information and emphasis, not merely narration wording.

records.structure: A finished original composition separates into actual useful layers.
records.gate: Only use source layers that really exist.

records.structure: A traveler crosses a coherent miniature environment.
records.gate: Preserve scale, route continuity and contact.

records.structure: Progressive sourced visual clues lead to one defensible answer.
records.gate: Use verified place identity and rights-cleared imagery.

records.structure: A symptom, diagnostic check, change and rechecked result.
records.gate: Distinguish observed repair from proposed fix.

records.structure: A bounded claim is tested and its exceptions are explained.
records.gate: Requires primary evidence; do not invent a popular myth.

records.structure: Original audio establishes a pattern that visual action transforms.
records.gate: Rights, accessibility and mix are separate checks.

records.structure: A recurring prop appears in genuinely different original conflicts.
records.gate: Each episode needs its own premise and resolution.

records.structure: A modeled object is assembled, rotated and checked.
records.gate: Distinguish illustrative assembly from safe build instructions.

records.structure: A sourced dataset answers a bounded question with visible units.
records.gate: Check denominator, scope, date and interpolation.

records.structure: The same mechanism alternates between schematic and tangible views.
records.gate: Keep correspondences exact and disclose simplifications.

source.section: Appendix C Creative banks and exact treatment addressing / Twenty editorial formats

editorial_treatment_rules: F01 explains the relationship through the story's visible action and bounded takeaway.
F02 asks the story question before a fair thinking hold, then resolves it from visible evidence. It is excluded from the public-safety group.
F03 separates one worked case into setup, action and a checked checkpoint.
F04 compares initial and changed conditions while isolating one justified variable; no invented counterfactual result.
F05 starts at the outcome, inspects clues, then replays the supported chain forward without overstating causality.
F06 stages a want, obstacle, committed choice, consequence and the authored ending.
F07 makes the costs of two plausible choices visible; an unexecuted alternate branch stays labeled proposed.
F08 gives the viewer a fair advance clue before the protagonist notices it; no last-second coincidence.
F09 lets readable actions and reactions carry the story with sparse captions and purposeful sound.
F10 retells the same conflict from an existing prop/helper viewpoint without inventing a new solution.
F20 alternates schematic and tangible representations of one relationship. Practical guidance needs an approved factual script first.

combination_rules.learning: Learning combinations fail if their comparison has no controlled basis, their backward trace overstates causality, or factual verification removes the premise.
combination_rules.fiction: Fiction combinations fail if their alternative choice, advance clue or object viewpoint requires a contrived new premise rather than illuminating the existing one.
combination_rules.every: Every combination inherits the story risks, format gate, approach gate, rights review, caption readability, motion comfort, audio mix and exact-byte checks.
